subject: Formal SLO Derogation Request — July 15 partial availability window
messages:
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@greenlane-commerce.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: SLO Team <slo@greenlane-commerce.com>, Tim Carter <tim.carter@greenlane-commerce.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Partial availability between 02:44–03:18 UTC — request for SLO derogation and evidence

Hi Soojin,

We saw a clear availability regression this morning that impacted our checkout flow for roughly ~34 minutes (02:44–03:18 UTC). The dashboard shows elevated 5xx rates and a spike in tail latency that caused request failures for several of our highest-value customers.

Can Redwood confirm the impacted window and provide the evidence bundle (raw traces, service logs, and ingress metrics) so we can begin our internal reconciliation? We also need to submit a formal SLO derogation request to procurement — please advise next steps and whether we qualify for a remedial credit under our contract.

I attached a filled request form and a short network capture from our side.

Thanks,
Alex Ruiz
Head of Platform — Greenlane Commerce
attachments: greenlane_network_capture.pcap (pcap), customer_impact_notes.txt (text)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@greenlane-commerce.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 09:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Partial availability between 02:44–03:18 UTC — request for SLO derogation and evidence

Hi Alex — thanks for the report and the attachments. We're actively pulling the telemetry. Quick answers up front:

- We see a regional control-plane preemption event that correlates with the window you reported.
- Preliminary classification: "partial availability" affecting a subset of tenants in us-west-2; impact looks like ~30–36 minutes for some API routes.

Next steps I will coordinate:
1) I will open an internal evidence pull request with Infra and SRE and share the raw bundle (traces, server logs, autoscaler events) by EOD PT.
2) Please complete the attached SLO derogation request form (I see you attached — thanks). We'll need the signed form back to route the credit evaluation.
3) I'll schedule a short sync (30m) with our SRE to walk through the traces if that helps.

Cc'ing Laura for contract eligibility and Marissa for credit calculations.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Customer Escalations Manager — Redwood Inference
attachments: request_acknowledgement.txt (text)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 10:22:48 -0700
Subject: Re: Partial availability between 02:44–03:18 UTC — request for SLO derogation and evidence

Soojin / team —

I reviewed Greenlane's contract (GL-2026-ACCT-0917). They are on our Standard Enterprise SLO with a 99.95% monthly availability guarantee and an availability credit clause that applies for verified partial outages.

For our process:
- We need the raw telemetry bundle from SRE + ingress telemetry (token-level breakdown preferred).
- Marissa, please provide a provisional credit estimate (prorated for the impacted window) and flag if this crosses our auto-approve threshold (> $25k).
- David, please pull the autoscaler logs and any node preemption traces for us-west-2 between 02:30–03:45 UTC. Include instance IDs and any hypervisor eviction signals.

I'll prepare the formal response to Greenlane once we have the evidence bundle and the credit calc.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2028 07:11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Partial availability between 02:44–03:18 UTC — request for SLO derogation and evidence

Quick provisional numbers: based on the account's monthly committed spend and the observed impact (approx 34 minutes of reduced availability on impacted routes), my rough prorate is $8,400 as a starting point. This assumes the incident qualifies under our contract terms and there are no sustained mitigation windows accounted for by prefix caching.

I'll refine this after we get the raw traces and the request form signed; if paper trail looks clean I can push an approval up to $10k. If it trends higher, we'll need a short executive exception (Laura) or to route via finance.

I am attaching a sample credit calc sheet and my working notes.
attachments: provisional_credit_calc.xlsx (xlsx)

From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@greenlane-commerce.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence bundle and next steps: Greenlane July 15 window (02:44–03:18 UTC)

Hi Alex / Greenlane SLO Team —

Attached is the evidence bundle from our side: raw traces (trace_ids.txt), service logs (api-server-logs-20280715.tar.gz), autoscaler events, and a short delta summary (rca_notes.txt). Key observations:

- Control-plane preemption triggered graceful eviction of worker pods in us-west-2 during 02:42–02:50 UTC; a separate autoscaler thrash later (03:02–03:10 UTC) caused increased request failures as pools rebalanced.
- Impact window with verified customer-facing 5xx responses: 02:44–03:18 UTC (consistent with your report).
- No evidence of malicious traffic or customer misconfiguration.

Attachments included: slo_evidence_bundle_20280715.zip, rca_notes.txt, trace_ids.txt

Next steps:
1) Please confirm receipt of the bundle and whether you want a joint postmortem sync (we can include SRE and product for 45m).
2) Marissa will follow up on the final credit calculation once you confirm the signed derogation request.

Thanks —
David Kim
Principal SRE — Redwood Inference
attachments: slo_evidence_bundle_20280715.zip (zip), rca_notes.txt (text), trace_ids.txt (text)
